title: Audit: "Sort by latest comment" in project media
summary: Read-through audit of the sort-by-latest-comment path in MediaTab — the DB query, API serialization, webhook ingest, and UI comparator. Core mechanism is correct (indexes are right, asset_id is always set, Map→Record doesn't drop entries, comparator nulls-last is intentional). Three behavioral issues were surfaced for user decision and NOT fixed in this entry: (1) LPOS-authored comments don't update the sort until the Frame.io webhook echoes back — a webhook delay or drop leaves the sort stale; (2) comment edits/completions/deletions don't bump recency because the webhook handler drops everything except comment.created — this is a design call about what 'latest' means; (3) webhook drops events when the asset's frameio.assetId no longer matches. Audit-only entry — no code changed.

title: Bulk transcript download streams a zip
summary: Rewrote /api/projects/[projectId]/transcripts/download-all from a concatenated plaintext blob to a streamed .zip, one .txt per transcript named by display filename, with collision-safe deduping. Same archiver+PassThrough pattern as photos/download-zip. Preserves a single-transcript fast path: when only one transcript exists, the route streams the single .txt directly with no zip wrapper, per the user's stated rule. Cross-browser/OS safe via standard application/zip + Content-Disposition headers; the existing 'Download all transcripts' button needs no change.

title: Copy-link button shows checkmark + "Link copied"
summary: Added in-button visual feedback to the 'Copy link to this asset' button in MediaDetailPanel's sidebar header. On a successful clipboard write the chain icon swaps to a checkmark, a green-tinted 'Link copied' label appears next to it, aria-label/title flip to 'Link copied', and the state resets after 1.8s. Mirrors the per-review-link copy pattern already used elsewhere in the same component. The existing success toast is kept as a redundant signal; the in-button affordance is now the primary cue.

title: Decouple attachment serving from Prospects access
summary: Fixed a bug where users without Prospects access couldn't open attachments on ordinary tasks. The shared attachment download endpoint (/api/attachment) serves both task-comment and prospect-update attachments but unconditionally required Prospects access, returning a 403 for everyone else. It now authorizes by the attachment's key prefix: task attachments (attachments/tasks/<id>/…) require only a valid session, matching how task-comment uploads are gated, while prospect attachments (attachments/<prospectId>/…) still require Prospects access. Keys are minted server-side so the prefix is a trusted discriminator; the R2 storage service, upload routes, data model, and frontend were already domain-correct and unchanged.

title: Notify original commenter when their comment gets a reply
summary: Added a new persistent notification category for media-comment replies, mirroring the existing Task/Prospect/Delivery notification slices. When a reply lands on a comment that was authored inside LPOS, the original commenter now gets a bell notification under a new 'Comments' tab — persisted in a comment_notifications table, pushed live via Socket.io ('comment:notification') plus best-effort web-push, and deep-linking to /projects/{id}?assetId={asset}. New model/store/service/hook/API routes were added and the reply POST handler resolves the parent author from comment-authors-store, firing only when an LPOS userId exists (external Frame.io reviewers have no in-app recipient) and skipping self-replies. The notif panel was widened to fit a 5th tab without clipping. Reply mechanism itself is unchanged.

title: Right-align comment "Reply" button
summary: Right-aligned the per-comment Reply trigger in both the media detail panel (.mad-reply-btn) and theater mode (.vt-cp-reply-btn) by giving each a fit-content block with margin-left:auto, so it sits at the right edge under each comment instead of bottom-left. CSS-only; the in-compose Reply/Cancel rows were already right-aligned. Reply mechanism unchanged: Frame.io has no reply endpoint, so LPOS posts a 'Reply to above:' top-level comment and reconstructs threads from a local replyId→parentId map.

title: Fix: checked-off Frame.io comment resets moments later
summary: Fixed a race where marking a Frame.io comment complete would optimistically check, then un-check itself moments later. The completed flag lives only in Frame.io; the user's PATCH triggers Frame.io's comment.completed webhook, which relays back as a comment-list refresh, but Frame.io's read API briefly lags its own webhook so the refetch returns the stale pre-toggle value. The optimistic guard (pendingTogglesRef) was cleared the instant the PATCH resolved — right before the echo landed — so it no longer masked the stale read; theater-mode toggles never set the guard at all. Now the optimistic value is sticky until a refetch confirms Frame.io has caught up (guard cleared only when a fetched comment's completed matches the pending value), the toggle handler keeps the guard on success, and theater-mode toggles register the guard too.

title: Move version chip from top-right to top-left
summary: Relocated the build version chip from `right: 8px` to `left: 8px` in `.version-tag` so it no longer competes visually with the notif-bell, user-menu, and storage-gear cluster on the right. Top-left at `top: 4px` sits above the breadcrumb bar (which starts at `top: 20px left: 32px`) and clear of the centered navbar pill — the only fully open corner of the shell.

title: Auto-advancing build version chip in top-right corner
summary: Added a tiny fixed-position chip in the top-right corner showing `v.<commit-count> · <short-sha>`. The commit count auto-advances on every git commit (and therefore every push); clicking the chip copies the full SHA so we can `git checkout` to the exact build a user reported a bug against — directly addressing the recent need to recover lost code. Implementation reads git via `execSync` once at server start in `lib/version.ts`, caches the result, passes it from the server `layout.tsx` to `AppShell` as a prop, and renders via `components/shell/VersionTag.tsx`. A `*` suffix appears when the running tree had uncommitted changes at boot.

title: Mobile layout audit and responsive fixes
summary: Audited every page group for elements overflowing on phone screens and appended a consolidated mobile-only CSS block to globals.css. Home tiles now wrap instead of clipping off-screen; the project workflow nav became a horizontal-scroll pill strip instead of 7 oversized stacked buttons; the client grid collapses 4 to 2 to 1 columns; slide-in side panels (shares, script editor) lift above the bottom tab bar; and several toolbars and media rows stop forcing horizontal overflow. All changes are gated behind max-width media queries, so the desktop layout is unchanged.

title: Add "All" scope tab to task board
summary: Added a third scope tab (All) to the Mine / Others toggle on the task board. Selecting All shows every task of the active type regardless of assignment. Required only a type union update and a new button — the existing filter already had a passthrough return true for unknown scopes.

title: HLS playback via hls.js
summary: Switched all video players from raw Frame.io originalUrl (raw uploaded file) to highQualityUrl (H.264 HLS transcode). Added useHlsPlayer hook that uses native HLS on Safari and hls.js on Chrome/Firefox/Edge. Fixes .mov playback cross-browser and improves scrubbing performance via adaptive bitrate streaming. Falls back to originalUrl if transcode not ready.

title: Git push to remote
summary: Staged and pushed 111 changed/new files from lpos-dashboard to github.com/lp-jordan/lpos main branch (commit 6584493). Excluded .DS_Store and atem-bridge.zip. Covers all accumulated changes since the 4-17-26 commit.

title: Sardius filename collision handling
summary: Added filename conflict detection to the Sardius push flow. The POST API now calls checkSardiusFileExists before starting an upload and returns HTTP 409 with a suggestedName ('filename(1).mp4') if the file already exists and the caller has not acknowledged. The SardiusPushModal handles the 409 by pausing the upload loop and presenting Overwrite / Rename options inline; for batch pushes, each conflicting asset is resolved in sequence before the loop continues.

title: Sardius FTP push feature
summary: Added a Sardius media push workflow accessible from the media asset More Info sidebar. A modal connects to the Akamai FTP watch-folder server, lists the remote directory tree, and lets the user pick a destination, set per-asset metadata (speakers, categories, publish profile), preview the JSON sidecar, and trigger a background FTP upload. After Sardius processes the file, the user pastes the assigned share URL back into LPOS where it is stored and available to copy with one click. Status cycles: none → uploading → queued → ready.
